Self-contained animated explainers for tidymodels concepts, built with Quarto
RevealJS + anime.js. Each concept is its own deck — embedded below, and openable
on its own. Use the arrow keys (or the on-slide controls) inside a deck to step
through its animation.

See `IDEAS.md` for the backlog of concepts to animate.
